info.title: CAPI Navigator API
info.description: REST API of CAPI Navigator. Authenticate either with the session cookie (`POST /api/auth/login`; mutating requests then need the header `x-capi-navigator: 1` against CSRF) or with an API token of a technical user (`Authorization: Bearer capin_…`). Every operation names the permission it needs; changes are audited.

Stored in a ConfigMap of the home cluster; existing namespaces change only with a rollout.

Requires permission `presets.manage`. This permission needs an unlimited role assignment.

default.description: Error with message and hint (400 invalid input, 401, 403, 404, 409, 502).

post.summary: Generate an API token for a technical user
post.description:
The response is the only time the token is returned; only its SHA-256 hash is stored. Use it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Requires permission `users.manage`. This permission needs an unlimited role assignment.

default.description: Error with message and hint (400 invalid input, 401, 403, 404, 409, 502).

delete.summary: Revoke an API token; it stops working at once
delete.description: Requires permission `users.manage`. This permission needs an unlimited role assignment.

default.description: Error with message and hint (400 invalid input, 401, 403, 404, 409, 502).

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description: Public: no session needed.

default.description: Error with message and hint (400 invalid input, 401, 403, 404, 409, 502).

get.summary: Readiness probe: caches synced
get.description:
Answers 503 until the caches of the home cluster are synced.

Public: no session needed.

default.description: Error with message and hint (400 invalid input, 401, 403, 404, 409, 502).

bearer.description: API token of a technical user (capin_…), generated in the user management. Requests with a token need no CSRF header and cannot manage users, roles or tokens.

Csrf.name: x-capi-navigator
Csrf.description: CSRF protection for mutating requests with the session cookie; not needed with an API token.
